messages:
clare (CS): Heads-up: Orbiton dedicated bring-up moved to Mon 07:30 PT. Need final signoff on quota windows, short smoke, and autoscale headroom. Can infra/sre confirm safe ramp?

omar (SRE): Proposed ramp: 5m warmup @ 15% qps -> 10m @ 40% -> 20m @ 75% -> 30m soak. Autoscale rules: scale-up if cpu_95>0.9 or queue_ms>1800 for 2m, scale-down after 8m stable below 60%. Rollback triggers: errors >4% for 10m or p95>3s for 12m.

mei (Infra): Add KV priming: 4m prefix-heavy pings before warmup. We'll pin model to rwin-v1.4-quant for 12h to limit variance. Also suggest limiting long-context jobs to 10 concurrent for first 2h.

neil (Solutions): Orbiton plans a +75m batch import. Request: a temporary embeddings quota cap during first 60m (100 rps) and a dashboard link for them. They also want a short smoke at 08:05 PT (after warmup + a bit of soak).

clare (CS): @mei confirm model pin + long-context limit? @omar include embedding throttle in autoscale doc? I'll ask Orbiton to hold big imports until we give the go.

mei (Infra): Confirmed: model pinned rwin-v1.4-quant for 12h and long-context concurrency limited to 10 via proxy config. I'll add notes to ticket CS-5233.

omar (SRE): Adding embeddings quota: temp_quota_embeddings=100rps for first_60m. Pasting autoscale snippet to CS-5233:

```
{"scale_up_when":"cpu_95>0.9 or queue_ms>1800","cooldown_up":"2m","scale_down_when":"cpu_5<0.6","cooldown_down":"8m","burst_headroom":{"factor":1.7,"duration":"4m","window":"first_90m"},"embeddings_temp_quota":"100rps"}
```

clare (CS): Great. Who triggers the smoke at 08:05?

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-5233 created: Orbiton dedicated bring-up orchestration. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5233

neil (Solutions): I'll run the smoke with Orbiton's SRE. Plan: 60 synthetic users hitting chat+embed for 6m. Will coordinate exact call.

mei (Infra): Fallback model staged: rwin-v1.3-fp16. Control-plane toggle ready.

clare (CS): Next steps (EOD): 1) omar paste autoscale + rollback to CS-5233, 2) mei add model pin + fallback note, 3) neil confirm smoke window with Orbiton, 4) I'll send runbook to customer.

omega (SRE): Autoscale JSON added to CS-5233.

mei (Infra): Model notes added.

neil (Solutions): Orbiton confirmed hold and smoke at 08:05 PT. I'll post final ack. :rocket:
